title: Hadwiger--Nelson Problem for Typical Norms
summary: The classical Hadwiger-Nelson problem asks for the chromatic number of the unit distance graph of the Euclidean plane. Over the years, this problem has been considered for a variety of other normed spaces, with higher-dimensional Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^d$ being perhaps the most natural and well-studied. Alon, Bucić, and Sauermann proved that, for a typical norm on $\mathbb{R}^d$, the chromatic number of the unit distance graph is at most $2^d$.
